Name: Wren's Expanded Greenhouse
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[b]
[size=4]May not be uploaded on any site other than nexusmods.com or Moddrop.com.[/size]

[u]FEATURES[/u]

[/b]- Seasonal backdrop! Compatible with [u]ALL[/u] recolors, retextures, etc. Choose from several options, or set it to auto to automatically match your farm!
- Custom image backdrop! Don't like the available options? Make your own! (Instructions below.)
- Choose your own glass! pick between several different frame colors and glass tints to match any color palette or personal taste.
- Swimming pond! Change behind the bush, then walk into the water along the top of the mini dock to get in. Can be changed to a more conventional pool.
- Optimized crop space! the central crop area is now 15x10 instead of 12x10, making best use of all sprinkler layouts.
- (A little) more crop space! 6 additional 3x3 crop spaces to the right. Can now be configured with different layouts!
- Rice irrigation! For the small crop area, the big one, or both!
- Optional expansion! A moderately sized area in the lower right which can be enabled or disabled in the config, and with several styles to choose from.
- Optional tunnel between cellar and greenhouse! Appears when enabled, and can be used when both cellar and greenhouse are unlocked.
- Different floor types!

[b][u]COMPATIBILITY

[/u][/b]- Compatible with all recolors/retextures. (Foliage Redone pictured)
- Uses custom glass for the greenhouse, so any modifications to the greenhouse glass from other mods won't be visible.
- Incompatible with anything else that replaces the greenhouse map, [s]including IFR2.[/s] [b]IFR2 compatible.

[u]CONFIGURATION

[/u][/b]- Frame: Selects the frame color of the greenhouse glass. options are 'vanilla', 'dark', 'light', 'copper', 'gold', and 'iridium'.
- Glass: Selects the style and color of the greenhouse glass panes. options are 'clear', 'glossy', 'pinkclear', 'greenclear', 'blackclear', 'blueclear', 'pinkglossy', 'greenglossy', 'blackglossy', 'blueglossy', and 'opaque'.
- Expansion: Selects the style of the optional expansion, or disables it. (disabled by default) options are 'disabled', 'default', 'plain', 'alternate', 'lounge', 'rows', and 'ricepaddy'.
- Backdrop: Selects the background style behind the glass. options are 'auto', 'default', 'forest', 'cliffs', 'rivers', 'beach', 'wilderness', 'image', and 'horizon'.
- Theme: Changes the color style of the greenhouse's accent tiles. options are 'light', 'soft', 'dark', and 'default'.
- Pool: The style of the pool. Options are 'default', 'tidal', and 'plain'.
- Irrigation: Adds water bins to the crop areas for rice irrigation purposes. Can be set to 'small', 'large', 'both', or 'none'.
- BigCropStyle: The layout style for the large crop area. Can be 'default', 'none', 'double', 'fancy', 'grove', 'planters', 'plots', or 'rows'.
- SmallCropStyle: The layout style for the small crop area. Can be 'default', 'none', 'double', 'planters', 'rows', or 'single'.
- Floor: Controls what type of floor to use. Can be 'default', 'grey', 'brick', 'wood', or 'grass'.
- SeasonMode: Sets the internal season of the greenhouse. Can be 'auto', 'spring', 'summer', 'fall', or 'winter'. 'Auto' will cause it to use whatever the outdoors season is. Note that using a setting other than 'auto' may cause strange behavior with certain recolors, depending on how they are set up.
- CellarTunnel: Enables/disables the 'tunnel' between the greenhouse and cellar. Can be 'true' or 'false'.

[u][b]INSTALLING WITH IFR2

﻿[u][b]Stardew 1.5 and later:[/b][/u]
[/b]
[/u][list=1]
[*]Download v1.4.0 or later of this mod
[*]Install both mods and run the game once
[*]It should now load fine
[*][u]IF IT STILL DOESN'T WORK[/u]:
In the IFR2 content patcher folder ([CP]), open the config and change "Disable_IF2R_Greenhouse" from "false" to "true", and change "Remove_Objects_From_Greenhouse" to "false".
[/list][u][b]

﻿Stardew 1.4 and earlier:
[/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]In the Mods folder, copy Greenhouse.tbin [b]out of [/b][CP] Wren's Expanded Greenhouse/assets and [b]into[/b] [CP] Immersive Farm 2 Remastered/Overrides.
[*]If you aren't running at least v1.1.1 of my mod, update it and run the game with it installed at least once.
[*]Open config.json in [CP] Wren's Expanded Greenhouse and under "IFR2 Compat", change "disabled" to "enabled". If you don't see this option, go back to step two.
[/list][b][u]
USING AN IMAGE BACKGROUND

[/u][/b]You can create your own backdrop using the existing placeholders (in assets/custom_backgrounds/Maps/) as references. You will need to create images of the same name and size and place them in "overrides/Maps/". If the folder does not exist you can create it.

[u][b]USING THE HORIZON BACKDROP

[/b][/u]To use the horizon backdrop, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4716]Map Utilities[/url], then change the backdrop option in config.json to "horizon"
Map Utilities is not currently updated for Stardew 1.5.
